children: Hindustan Unilever Limited (NSE:HINDUNILVR) reported Q2 revenue +14.8% and volume +7% with EBITDA and PAT +8%, flagged persistent input inflation and margin pressure, reiterated guidance while pursuing measured price hikes, interim dividend and possible buyback as brokers remain broadly bullish.
Previous Week Recap
Hindustan Unilever Limited: Q2 Highlights
: Hindustan Unilever (HINDUNILVR) Q2: sales rose, volumes grew, margins contracted and EBITDA guidance reiterated; company flagged persistent input inflation and ongoing calibrated price actions.
Revenue Up, Volume Growth
: HINDUNILVR Q reports: revenue +14.8% YoY, volume +7%. Home Care sales +22%, Beauty & Wellbeing +16%. EBITDA and PAT both +8%.
Commodity Inflation Pressures Pricing
: HINDUNILVR says commodity inflation will stay high near term and it will roll out measured price hikes to manage costs while prioritizing volume growth amid ongoing input-cost pressure.
Interim Dividend Declared Rs 19
: HINDUNILVR announced an interim dividend of Rs 19 per share for FY2027; record date Nov 12, 2026, payment scheduled Nov 25, 2026.
Bullish Brokerages With Targets
: Brokerages kept bullish calls on HINDUNILVR: Motilal Oswal Buy target ₹2,150, JM Financial Buy target ₹2,225, Elara Accumulate target ₹2,100. Notes: 7% volume growth, margin pressures.
Possible Share Buyback Consideration
: Hindustan Unilever (HINDUNILVR) said it may consider a share buyback, citing ample cash and stock underperformance; a buyback would be the first since 2011.
Margin Pressure From Cost Pressures
: HINDUNILVR sees margin pressure from rising crude palm oil and LAB costs; government cut of crude palm oil import duty to 5% may ease gross margins. Coffee down, tea up among input-cost moves.
PL Capital Upgrades To Buy
: PL Capital upgraded Hindustan Unilever (HINDUNILVR) to Buy, citing attractive valuation and growth in the consumer sector amid inflation; HUL highlighted alongside Tata Consumer Products.
D2C Premium Beauty Expansion
: HINDUNILVR expanded D2C premium beauty; Minimalist skincare crossed ₹1,000 crore revenue as company targets affluent consumers with specialized products.
DigiDukaan OnDC Integration
: Hindustan Unilever (HINDUNILVR) joins ONDC’s DigiDukaan, linking retailers to brands in Hyderabad, Jaipur and Mumbai; enables digital ordering with live pricing, trade schemes and stock visibility.
